analysis.purpose: Builds the media worker JSON payload as a pure function with no input or output of its own, keeping the Python side to a minimal contract while the TypeScript layer owns graph identity.
responsibilities: Shape worker output into the payload the ingest layer consumes
Stay pure: no filesystem or network access

businessRules.rule: The contract is deliberately minimal — graph identity and schema conformance are computed on the TypeScript side, not here.
businessRules.rationale: Two languages deriving ids independently would eventually disagree, and id determinism is what the whole graph rests on.

nodes.name: Worker payload
nodes.summary: Minimal cross-language contract for media workers.
